project_context.title: Gateway STEM Success and Institutional Capacity Building
project_context.framework: Federal Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200) Compliance Framework

conversation_history.content: Initial prompt uploading project parameters and requesting GSO persona activation.
Persona activated. Confirmed core project parameters: fiscal scope ($590,098.56), demographic baselines, Banner ERP codes, and FERPA cell suppression rules.
Request for Search Committee Matrix.
Provided Asset 16: Search Committee Interview Matrix & Questions tailored for a 0.5 FTE STEM Program Coordinator, including 1-5 scoring rubric, core domains, and evaluation scorecard.
Request for a layman's explanation of the Grant process.

Provided an analogical overview of the 5 key grant lifecycle phases (Blueprint, Building the Sandbox, Steering the Ship, Checking Receipts, Packing Up) comparing the grant to a community center built with seed funds.
Request to map all 35 project assets to the 5 lifecycle phases in the same layman tone.
Mapped and explained all 35 project assets chronologically from Asset 1 (Pre-Award baseline matrix) through Asset 33 (Closeout handover transition memo) and the aggregators (Assets 34 & 35).
Request for Printable Master Proposal Guide template.
Generated copy-pasteable Markdown template for Asset 35 (Master Proposal Guide & Institutional Compliance Blueprint) with placeholder slots for future proposals.
Request for a blank Budget Justification Worksheet table calculated using local fringe benefits rates.

Provided Appendix A: Budget Justification Worksheet containing pre-loaded UNM Main Campus projected fringe rates (44.23% full-time, 25.97% part-time staff, 1.00% student employee) and narrative templates.
Request for an automated multi-year Excel budget workbook with variance warnings and a summary tab.

Executed an openpyxl script compiling 'grant_budget_justification_worksheet.xlsx' with individual year tabs, a cross-sheet Budget Summary, a 2 CFR 200.308 Variance Dashboard (25% alert logic), and a FERPA Privacy Sandbox Tracker (cell suppression masks).
Request for complete written text narrative justification template matching the Excel sums.
Drafted the full copy-pasteable Budget Justification Narrative with line-by-line calculations matching the numerical sums and fringe rates used in the spreadsheet workbook.
Request for explanation of why a Budget Justification Narrative is standard.
Explained the standard role of the narrative as an itemized 'explanation receipt' providing the math and logic behind expenditures to satisfy accountability and audit trails.
Request for Facilities, Equipment, and Other Resources Narrative isolated from cost-sharing risk.

Drafted a qualitative-only Facilities Narrative detailing Chemistry Wet Labs, the Academic Support Center, and GSO infrastructure completely omitting quantitative dollar figures to shield against voluntary committed cost-sharing risks.
Request for universal budget justification narrative template for future funding agency models (NSF, NIH, DOE).

Generated specialized modular and detailed pre-award justification text blocks for the National Science Foundation (NSF PAPPG), National Institutes of Health (NIH PHS 398), and Department of Energy (DOE Office of Science).
Request for interactive web forms for the DOE Budget Narrative, Institutional Compliance Check Matrix, and Post-Award Handover Guide (Asset 10).

Compiled standalone HTML5 webpage workspaces ('doe_budget_narrative_form.html', 'grant_proposal_compliance_matrix.html', and 'post_award_handover_guide.html') loaded with dynamic validation scripts, file size estimators, and timeline calculators.
Request for automated Monthly Voucher Audit spreadsheet (Asset 25).

Generated 'grant_voucher_audit_workflow.xlsx' via Python script, establishing allowability check triggers under 2 CFR 200 and a zero-indirect isolation sandbox for Participant Support Costs (Code 40A0).
Request for fillable Monthly GSO Accomplishments Memo template webpage (Asset 22).

Built and displayed code for 'gso_monthly_accomplishments_memo.html', an interactive blank web layout designed to track monthly fiscal data, project metrics, regulatory updates, and export compiled text via the clipboard.
